pages.name: Foglet
pages.text: Туманник — Foglet. The shape moving behind the fog is rarely alone.

pages.title: Habitat
pages.text: Swamps, mangrove swamps, dark forests and old-growth birch forests. Requires low light.

pages.title: Behavior
pages.text: Inflicts blindness and slowness, briefly vanishes, relocates safely and creates up to two combat copies.

pages.title: Weaknesses
pages.text: Necrophage elixir and oil. Decoys give no loot and soon disappear.

pages.title: Loot
pages.text: Essence: 65 percent, 1–2. Claw: 35 percent. Head: 10 percent with a player or tamed ally’s killing blow.

pages.title: Hunter’s advice
pages.text: Do not waste time on decoys. Leave the fog veil and wait for the original to return.
